requirements.requirement: Repair and operate server.py as a local service using /srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/run/status.sock.
requirements.summary: The repaired server runs under systemd as statusd, is active and enabled, and listens on the required Unix-domain socket. It also recovered automatically after a verified reboot.

requirements.requirement: Limit service access to the statusd service owner and status-readers members, and provision status-reader and outsider accounts reflecting those roles.
requirements.summary: The socket is owned by statusd:status-readers with mode 0660 inside a mode-0750 directory. statusd and status-reader connected successfully, while outsider was denied. Account and group membership observations match the requested roles.

requirements.requirement: Return the supplied status document for exactly STATUS followed by a newline, and return an error for other requests.
requirements.summary: Exact STATUS newline requests returned the 24-byte document. BOGUS, STATUS extra, and NOT-STATUS requests returned exactly ERROR followed by a newline, including after reboot.
The status document retained its original 24-byte content and SHA-256 digest before repair, before reboot, after reboot, and in the final audit.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were unchanged after execution and reboot. The service uses the already-installed Python 3 runtime and systemd.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart scheduling, changed boot identity from 180a78a0-8a84-45ff-82f1-cd734208a369 to f1f0fd08-457f-4a7f-815d-3120dff0ddb8, and demonstrated recovered service, protocol, access controls, data, platform, and system health. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Requirement document-preservation cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account/group creation, server and unit installation, ownership and permission changes, and service enablement in cmd-ae0d747cf2b640ce directly established the required service and access boundary. Temporary test and rollback files were used for bounded verification and removed in cmd-9e52231dd49047e1, cmd-e210198643b142c3, and cmd-e99d04a636374101. The reboot scheduled by cmd-b7be2adcd87c494c was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol. Final observations show no failed services, damaged package state, network exposure, or abandoned test files; the new systemd-private statusd directory is expected service-managed state.
